notes: Searches: all 6 used. Fetches: 50 of 60 used. Coverage: MD, VA and WV all searched; DC had no card show in range in any search result, so none recorded. Known shows skipped as instructed: Apex TCG Show, Digimon DC Regional, Mountain State Collectors Convention, SWU Homeworlds Baltimore, The Best Flippin' Card Show, Elite Collectibles Expo. Records: 15 total. The MegaVA Card Show (May 14 and 15 2027, Fredericksburg Convention Center) is taken from the venue event page, which prints the year and matches the weekdays; the organizer is not named, and the page sends visitors to a listing site I did not fetch. Maryland Trading Card Expo booth prices come from its vendor info page, which conflicts with its FAQ ($128 versus $125); both are recorded in the table notes. The 10 Tidewater Cards & Collectibles editions are recorded from the organizer's schedule, which prints no year next to each date. I recorded them because the page's section heading reads 2026 Show Calendar and each weekday agrees with 2026 (checked with date). Confidence is medium for those 10. The Short Pump edition is hosted by DashKo Promotions per the same page. Tidewater's vendor reservations are by phone number, which is not recorded. Card City Expo: the organizer page prints Jan 30 and 31 without a year. The year 2027 comes from the Fredericksburg Convention Center event page, and weekdays match. NOVA TCG Exchange: each date on the organizer schedule carries its year. Recorded as a series with rule freq none; no last_confirmed because the page has no post date. Dulles Moms Reston show: a past edition with 250 plus tables. Organizer not named (the page points to ontreasure.com, a listing site that I did not fetch). Admission is conflicting ($5 in the link text, free in the URL), so left out. Status is left out because the show has already happened. Guessed organizer domains that did not resolve or refused: baltimorecardshow.com, midatlanticsportscardshow.com, tcceventcenter.com, thetcgcon.com (TLS error), pokekonfest.com, pokekon.com (refused), clarksburgcardsexpo.com, bstrevents.com, 757cardsandcabinets.com, wvcards4you.com, novasportscardshow.com, vbfieldhouse.com, and rvaexpo.com (empty page). Time sensitive: a Virginia Beach 757 Card Show may run Oct 24 and 25 2026, and Tidewater's Harrisonburg show is Oct 24 2026. Both need a same-week check.
